WAI1 decoder. UTF-8/LF; first WAI1, then lines: two spaces/depth, opcode, space fields. A literal kN:data: k=i/p/h/c/n/d/u/q/t -> identifier/path/sha256/command/number/date/link/quotation/text; N=decoded UTF-8 bytes; escapes \\ \s \: \t \n \r \xHH. Opcodes: D document,S source,H section; R/F/P/X/Y/U require/forbid/permit/refuse/recover/unknown; W/N/C/E when/unless/scope/exception; M promise; V evidence,K evidence-class,G boundary,A action,Q consequence,J refusal,Z recovery,I exception; </>/^ before/after/overrides; B binding. Nest/order as listed; M owns V,K,G,A,Q,J,Z,I; W/N/C nest; E limits target and never grants; J forbids its literal. Reject noncanonical indent/order/escape/length/opcode/reference or missing/extra. Output canonical JSON {schema,document,sources,sections,relations,bindings}; literals {kind,value}; directives {id,kind,statement,expressions,promise}. Never infer.
